correctness.rationale: Direct partial transposition gives two positive scalar blocks and \(n-1\) explicit \(2\times2\) Hermitian blocks. Each has positive trace and determinant \(\tfrac14(p_{k-1}p_{k+1}-p_k^2)\), so its inertia is determined exactly by one local log-concavity comparison. Summing yields \((n+1+V,E,L)\); the binomial and geometric corollaries follow from exact adjacent-ratio identities.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete inertia classification on the diagonal simplex of a standard maximal entangled/NPT subspace, not an arbitrary parameter slice. It identifies a sharp structural boundary: strict discrete log-concavity is exactly the condition for saturating the universal negative-eigenvalue bound, while geometric weights create \(n-3\) exact zero modes. The binomial family gives a simple closed-form all-dimensional maximizer in contrast with the inspected semidefinite-programming existence construction.
